name: cinefile-rules-tests
description: Security-rules tests for firestore.rules. Run with `npm test` from this directory (requires Java for the Firestore emulator).

scripts._comment: Runs from the repo root: firebase-tools refuses a rules file outside the project directory, and firestore.rules lives at the root next to firebase.json. The demo- project prefix keeps the emulator fully offline (no credentials, no network).
scripts.test: cd .. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cinefile "node --test test_rules/rules.test.mjs"
